Take an edited flat-view workbook back into the YAML spec

Source: R/spec_xlsx_import.R
tfl_import_spec_xlsx.Rd

The workbook tfl_write_spec_xlsx() wrote, edited in Excel, read back: each row is matched by its key (toc: id; datasets: dataset; populations: id; analysis_data and analyses: output_id + id; codelists: output_id + variable + value; tokens: output_id + name; header / footer / titles / footnotes: output_id + line; page / report: output_id; listing_cols: output_id + vars) and the item it names is updated with the row's cells; a row with a new key is added; an item the workbook no longer has is reported (missing), not removed. Cells read as the converter reads sheets: a | b a list, (none) an !unset, the columns that hold R as !r. Nothing else of the YAML files changes.

Usage

tfl_import_spec_xlsx(dir, path, write = TRUE)

Arguments

dir

The study folder (or its spec/).

path

The workbook.

write

Write the changed YAML files? FALSE only reports.

Value

Invisibly, a list: changes (a data frame: sheet, key, column, from, to), added (keys new to the spec), missing (keys of the spec the workbook lacks), files (written).
